answer: By the oasis of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, diluted when peers disagree, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. The vault is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the delta.
